cards.text: WEEKENDER GS-BIRKIN-01 — SHIPPED CUT (WHITNEY)

cards.title: CONCEPT
cards.text: Finished 79.2s greenscreen AI UGC. Every frame below is pulled from the rendered ad, not a mockup. Creator keyed bottom-left at 32% width for the full runtime, burned captions on the VO word timestamps, one continuous ElevenLabs Woman Over 30 read on eleven v3 creative. Two more creator variations (Brooks, Anna) are in matting and drop into the identical bed. File: VEL-WEEKENDER-GS-BIRKIN-01-whitney.mp4 in the Weekender video library.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: Okay, if you travel at all, I need to show you something.
Bag beside a silver roller at the front door.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
curiosity

Opens on her situation, not the product. No season anywhere in the read.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: I used to check a bag for every single trip,
Bag on the entryway bench with a trench coat.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
recognition

Our bag stays on screen through the whole problem. No rival product ever appears.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: because I could never fit everything into something that also looked good.
Bag on the bed with a packing flatlay.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
frustration

This is the bind the mechanism resolves four beats later.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: My old duffel held everything, but it looked like a gym bag.
Bag styled on the bed.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
frustration

The dismissal lives in the VO over OUR bag. No duffel on screen.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: And my nice bags held basically nothing.
Bag on the sofa, full silhouette, scale reads.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
frustration

Scale reads here, setting up the payoff of 'scaled up' two beats later.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: This is the Weekender from Velantra.
Clean front hero on the console.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
reveal

Brand fed to TTS as Vell-Ahn-Trah. Burned caption corrected to Velantra (Scribe spells it by ear).

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: It's a Birkin-inspired shape, just scaled up to a travel bag.
Bag sitting on top of a full-size carry-on. Silhouette dead front-on, scale unmistakable against known luggage.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
the click

THE MECHANISM BEAT. The frame carries both halves of the line at once: silhouette AND travel scale. The word Birkin never entered a generation prompt, it lives only in VO and caption.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: So it holds three days of clothes, plus my laptop, my chargers, all of it,
Laptop sliding down into the open bag.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
relief

The claim gets its literal demo. The laptop goes in on screen.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: and it keeps its shape whether it's packed full or half empty.
Open and packed with a knit and jeans, walls standing straight.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
reassurance

First trim candidate if a shorter TOF cut is wanted.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: The whole inside is this soft caramel leather with a big slip pocket,
Hands lowering a knit in, caramel leather interior visible.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
sensory

Interior reads as caramel LEATHER, never cream canvas. Verified on the frame.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: and the top flap just folds back so I can see everything at once.
Open bag, one-piece flap folded fully back.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
satisfaction

Flap mechanism law: one piece, folded all the way over.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: I packed it for a three day trip and I didn't check a single thing.
Packed and standing beside the roller.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
confidence

Second trim candidate. The next beat makes the same point harder.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: It slides right into the overhead bin, so I walk straight past the bag drop line every time.
Closed bag resting inside an open overhead bin, real cabin below, no person.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
smugness

The ONLY new generation in the ad. No-person product still, frame-first with a slow push-in, never a video engine. Overhead bin is live PDP copy; under-seat is not a verified claim.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: I've taken it to three cities in the last two months, and I get stopped about it constantly.
Carry and walk, cropped below the chin.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
pride

One-creator lock held: the b-roll model's face is cropped out so nothing competes with the keyed presenter.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: People always ask if it's a designer bag.
Macro, gold turn lock and clasp plates.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
validation

The hardware is what reads as designer, so the frame answers the line.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: There's no logo anywhere on it,
Macro across clean leather, no branding anywhere.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
discernment

There genuinely is no logo, inside or out.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: it comes in four colors,
Live PDP, the four colour swatches.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
consideration

Captured from the live page 8/21. Black is a pre-order shipping mid September; the other three ship now. Put that split in the ad copy, not in her mouth.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: and they sell it for about a hundred and sixty dollars.
Live PDP, $209.99 struck to $159.99, Save $50.00.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
surprise

She says 'they sell it', never 'we'. Price verified live.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: So if you're tired of paying for checked bags, or you just want one bag that actually does everything,
Bag on the entry bench with the coat.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
resolve

Third trim candidate, the CTA is doubled.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: go look at Velantra. They're running a sale right now and colors sell out fast, so I'd get yours quickly.
PDP scroll toward the buy box.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
urgency

Season stripped off the sale so the asset survives 9/1.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: I've left the link below.
PDP settled on Add To Cart.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
resolve

Closes on the page, not on her, exactly like the reference.

cards.title: SHIPPED — Whitney cut, 79.2s  ·  frames pulled from the rendered ad

cards.text: NOTES

cards.title: What shipped
cards.text:
79.2 seconds, 1080x1920.

Creator: HeyGen Avatar V, keyed and composited bottom-left at 32% of frame width for the entire runtime.

Voice: ElevenLabs Woman Over 30 on eleven v3 creative preset, one continuous take, never chained.

Captions cut on Scribe word timestamps, max 4 words, flushed at terminal punctuation.

cards.title: Two bugs caught and fixed
cards.text:
1. The burned captions come from the STT transcript, which spells the brand by ear as 'Velentra'. That would have shipped a misspelled brand name in two cards. Corrected at render.

2. The creator PiP started at 44% of frame width, which put captions across her face. Brought down to 32%, matching the reference ad's corner presence.

cards.title: Assets
cards.text:
Only ONE new asset was generated for this ad: the overhead bin still.

Everything else came from the existing Weekender b-roll library (lc-travel and onroute series) plus a fresh headless capture of the live PDP.

cards.title: Two more creators coming
cards.text:
Brooks (car selfie) and Anna (hallway) rendered on the same VO and drop into the identical bed.

Neither has a green screen, so both are being matted before they can be composited as cutouts.

cards.title: Still open
cards.text:
Runtime is 79.2s against a 41-53s norm for this format. Recommendation stands: ship the full read as MOF and retargeting, and cut the four marked trim lines for a shorter cold TOF version.

Also open: the standing house law says Birkin stays out of Velantra copy, while our own PDP already says 'Birkin-inspired silhouette'. That law text needs resolving.
